title: Structures and Spectral and Magnetic Properties of a Series of Carbacylamidophosphate Pentanuclear Lanthanide(III) Hydroxo Complexes

material_class.structural_family: square-pyramidal Ln5(μ3-OH)4(μ4-OH) core with ten dimethyl N-benzoylamidophosphate ligands

synthesis.procedure: Compounds 2–5 were prepared by the previously reported method. For 1, a suspension of the precipitated hydrated ternary neodymium complex in water was stirred at 70 °C for 30 min to complete hydrolysis. The precipitate was filtered, washed with water, and dried in a desiccator over CaCl2. The dry powder was dissolved in CH2Cl2 and 2-propanol was layered on the solution. Crystals were filtered, washed with 2-propanol, and dried. No numerical reagent amounts are given in this article.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aqueous suspension hydrolysis followed by CH2Cl2/2-propanol layering
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered, washed with water, dried over CaCl2, redissolved in CH2Cl2, and crystallized by layering 2-propanol; crystals washed with 2-propanol and dried.

properties.summary: High-resolution absorption spectra were measured at 300 and 4 K. The 4 K 4I9/2 → 2P1/2 band shows two components assigned to the apical Nd site and the two similar basal sites. Emission of 1 was too weak to detect under 266 nm excitation because of multiphonon quenching, energy migration, and cross-relaxation.

properties.summary: Weak Dy(III) emission at 300 K is observed only under 266 nm laser excitation, dominated by 4F9/2 → 6H13/2; lifetimes were not detectable. Dc susceptibility is governed by crystal-field splitting of 6H15/2. Ac data show slow magnetic relaxation in 0 and 500 Oe with a small effective barrier; no hysteresis was found at 2 K and the Cole–Cole plot shows a single process.

A very weak out-of-phase ac signal appears in a 1000 Oe dc field, consistent with possible slow relaxation, but no significant relaxation parameters were extracted.

properties.summary: Absorption spectra were recorded at 300 and 4 K; the hypersensitive band at 4 K has more Stark components than expected for one Er site, consistent with three crystallographic positions. Emission was not detectable. Dc χMT is accounted for by crystal-field splitting of 4I15/2. No out-of-phase ac signal was detected in 0 or 1000 Oe dc fields.

properties.summary: Weak Yb(III) 2F5/2 → 2F7/2 emission is observed at 77 and 300 K after 266 nm excitation. The zero-phonon line is near 975 nm in both absorption and emission; broad emission features near 1007–1035 nm arise from ligand-field splitting, which could not be fully assigned because three nonequivalent Yb sites are present. Lifetimes were not detectable. No magnetic data are reported for 5.
